channel.title: MexIHC 2026 - News (EN)
channel.description: Official RSS feed for MexIHC 2026 news and updates in English.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 Poster Track deadline extended
item.description: The submission deadline for the Poster Track was extended from September 6 to September 13, 2026. The acceptance notification moved to September 23, and the camera-ready deadline moved to September 28, 2026.

item.title: Registration and payment now open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: The Registration System and payment instructions for MexIHC 2026 are now available, including bank information for payments within Mexico. Check the getting started guide too. The deadline for author registration payment is September 25, 2026.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 accepted workshops deadlines extended again
item.description: The submission deadline for accepted workshops was extended from August 29, 2026 to September 5, 2026, and the acceptance notification moved from September 2 to September 9, 2026. Workshop papers of up to 6 pages and 2-page position papers are accepted.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 Posters and Student Design Competition deadlines extended
item.description: The submission deadlines for the Poster Track and Student Design Competition were extended from August 30, 2026 to September 6, 2026.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 accepted workshops paper submission deadline extended
item.description: The centralized paper submission deadline for accepted MexIHC 2026 workshops was extended from August 20, 2026 to August 29, 2026.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 Student Design Competition deadline extended
item.description: The Student Design Competition submission deadline was extended from August 16, 2026 to August 30, 2026 and later to September 6, 2026.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 Graduate Colloquium deadline extended
item.description: The Graduate Colloquium submission deadline was extended from August 9, 2026 to August 16, 2026.

item.title: Call for Papers of accepted workshops at MexIHC 2026
item.description: Check out the call for papers and websites of the accepted workshops for MexIHC 2026 (IMSaBi, Reimagining HCI, Aging at Home). The centralized deadline for submitting papers to workshops was extended from August 20, 2026 to August 29, 2026.

item.title: Call for Papers deadline extended again for MexIHC 2026
item.description: The paper submission deadline was extended from June 15, 2026 to June 21, 2026.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 Accessibility Recommendations for Authors updated
item.description: Check the updated accessibility recommendations for MexIHC 2026 authors, aligned with WCAG 2.2. Includes inclusive language guidance, accessible documents, presentations, and videos with subtitles.

item.title: Gillian Hayes announced as the second MexIHC 2026 keynote speaker
item.description: Read the talk abstract and biography of Gillian Hayes, the second confirmed keynote speaker for MexIHC 2026.

item.title: Roberto Martínez-Maldonado announced as the first MexIHC 2026 keynote speaker
item.description: Read the talk abstract and biography of Roberto Martínez-Maldonado, the first confirmed keynote speaker for MexIHC 2026.

item.title: Call for Poster Track is open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: Check the MexIHC 2026 Call for Poster Track. The submission deadline is September 6, 2026.

item.title: Call for Graduate Colloquium is open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: Check the MexIHC 2026 Graduate Colloquium call. The submission deadline is August 16, 2026.

item.title: Call for Papers deadline extended for MexIHC 2026
item.description: The paper submission deadline was extended from June 1, 2026 to June 15, 2026.

item.title: Workshop deadline extended for MexIHC 2026
item.description: The workshop proposal deadline was extended from May 25, 2026 to June 8, 2026. The acceptance notification moved from May 29, 2026 to June 12, 2026.

item.title: Student Design Competition is open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: Check the 2026 Student Design Competition call and submit your proposal before September 6, 2026.

item.title: Call for Tutorials is open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: The organizing committee invites the submission of tutorial proposals on topics related to HCI.

item.title: Call for Workshops is open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: Check the MexIHC 2026 Call for Workshops and submit your proposal before June 8, 2026.

item.title: Call for Papers is open for MexIHC 2026
item.description: Check submission guidelines, topics, and important dates for the Call for Papers. The submission deadline is June 21, 2026.

item.title: MexIHC 2026 conference dates announced
item.description: MexIHC 2026 will take place October 27-30, 2026 in Ensenada, Baja California.
